notes: Skills browser: chat top bar now opens a Skills sheet powered by host 0.3.2's GET /sessions/{id}/skills. It lists the session's real user-invocable skills with descriptions (loading/retry/unsupported/empty/session-unavailable states), and tapping one prefills the composer with 'Use the <name> skill: ' without sending; blank-line append, cursor at end, 5-minute per-session cache and copy fallback. Live host currently exposes 14 skills. Also includes preset/lineage, local+remote Markdown images, tool output viewer and PDF export from recent releases.
